diagnostic_policy.compiler: Preserve the unchanged original OKL diagnostic when core compilation rejects first. Adapter diagnostics apply only after successful ordinary compilation or at the canonical record boundary.
diagnostic_policy.delivered_reader: CLEARANCE, IDENTITY, SIBLING, TOPOLOGY, FRAME and UNSUPPORTED are independent audit finding classes retained under an OTRAY-E-DELIVERY envelope; structural parse failure does not satisfy a required geometric negative.
diagnostic_policy.multiple_independent_mutations: Each listed variant is a separate fixture, changed one field or one named semantic feature at a time. The executable input lock expands every variant and fixes its exact expected existing/compiler or adapter diagnostic before native work. No one corrupted fixture combines several independent failures.
precedence: existing source compilation or direct-record structural validation
diagnostic_policy.structural_precedence: The exact canonical-record schema can reject a mutated enum/encoding before finite numeric or rotation checks. A one-field control must expect that actual stage; it may not insist on a later code. Source syntax and quaternion-domain failures retain existing OKL errors. A valid sign-reversed literal source quaternion is positive, while noncanonical record bits are negative.
diagnostic_policy.within_stage: Report all bounded discovered violations sorted by semantic ID and code. No priority race is inferred. Exact unchanged compiler errors remain unchanged.

future_qualification_limits.accepted_pointer_rule: BUILT_PENDING_RECEIVING leaves accepted pointer untouched. Required native-scene/GLB receiving measurements must pass before conditional promotion, all within one monotonic transaction deadline.
future_qualification_limits.host_allowance_authority: C198 finite future static-tray qualification decision; input lock must request and record effective limit. Not a source budget increase or historical gate relaxation; zero C198 execution.
future_qualification_limits.rule: A failed/timeout/cancelled start consumes its slot. Stop remaining slots on any unexpected result, preserve evidence, then revise/review before a new versioned attempt. These are ceilings, not permission to execute in C198.

independent_reader_geometry_rules.corner_assignment: Unique measured bounding-box corner within maximum component distance tolerance; all eight buckets present; lexicographically smallest actual tuple per bucket; every bucket member within tolerance of representative
independent_reader_geometry_rules.finding_accumulation: On structurally valid measurable geometry, collect every required bounded finding; generic GEOMETRY/FRAME does not replace required CLEARANCE or SIBLING
independent_reader_geometry_rules.orientation: Actual triangle cross product dotted with expected outward face direction strictly positive
independent_reader_geometry_rules.overlap: Forbidden for solid parts when all three measured intersection lengths exceed δ; payload proxy excluded from matter, still clearance-checked
independent_reader_geometry_rules.signed_volume: Exact rational triangle sum from decoded binary values; positive; compare to expected product with (sx+2δ)(sy+2δ)(sz+2δ)-sx*sy*sz allowance

later_admission_limits.per_route: one baseline plus one clean regeneration

numeric_encoding.format: Exactly 16 lowercase hex digits for eight big-endian IEEE-754 binary64 bytes; no float.hex syntax
numeric_encoding.name: binary64-be-hex/1
numeric_encoding.negative_zero: Reject noncanonical received negative zero; producer normalizes to positive zero
numeric_encoding.rounding: Use SPECIFICATION per-operation nearest-even binary64 operation order; no reassociation

origin: New C198 technical qualification fixtures; not historical requirements, native observations or the future author-admission protocol

tolerances.regeneration_equality: exact raw GLB and final GLB byte equality; no volatile field exceptions
tolerances.right_sibling_equality: exact stable-ID, geometry, transform, topology and material values in canonical sibling closure; ignore unrelated GLB index renumbering only
